title: Machine learning and single-cell analysis nominate NCF1 and GPR34 in hypertrophic scarring
summary: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis found macrophages with prominent nucleotide-metabolism activation in hypertrophic scar, and an Enet + svmLinear diagnostic model on public transcriptomic data reached an AUC of 0.934, with SHAP analysis picking NCF1 and GPR34 as key genes. In THP-1-derived M2 macrophages, these genes promoted TGF-beta1 secretion and fibroblast activation, and knockdown reduced alpha-smooth muscle actin and collagen I expression. Largely bioinformatic and in vitro; the AUC is probably an internal estimate.
ai_technology: Enet + svmLinear diagnostic model with SHAP feature attribution on transcriptomic data

evidence.tested: In vitro knockdown in THP-1-derived M2 macrophages.
evidence.unknown: Independent validation of the AUC, in vivo role and clinical use; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning models built the diagnostic signature and SHAP selected the key genes.
